mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate compresses equity valuations through increased discount rates applied to future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as a continuous variable.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns show a positive Rank IC with FEDFUNDS (IC > 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window, or average returns when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in federal funds rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals aggressive monetary tightening that reduces corporate investment and consumer spending, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC between trigger and returns < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint movement of UNRATE falling and PAYEMS rising fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >40% of instances, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-growth economic regime, rising housing starts and consumer credit availability indicate robust demand for goods and services, supporting corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >40% of periods where HOUST and RSAFS both rise, or joint signal Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction that signals economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of INDPRO < 100 instances, or Rank IC between INDPRO and returns < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate, as a continuous variable, reflects stronger labor market conditions that increase household income and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns show negative Rank IC with UNRATE (IC < -0.03) over any 3-year rolling window, or average returns when UNRATE < 3.5% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increase in housing starts and consumer credit availability indicates robust demand for residential construction and consumer goods, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in >40% of instances, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%), a federal funds rate above 5.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening to curb inflation, increasing borrowing costs and reducing corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC for joint condition < 0.03.
